_comment: The six-section docstring skeleton, as a ratchet. `migrated` only grows; the debt only falls.
docstring 六段骨架，做成棘轮：`migrated` 只增，欠账只降。
**Where the form comes from: it was measured.** Six Doxygen `@par` headings -- the obvious encoding -- are impossible
in this pipeline. `docfmt` repairs a body line that starts with a tag (the docs pipeline would assign it to the wrong
language group), so it strips the `@` and merges the six sections into one paragraph. Three other shapes were tried
and rewritten the same way. What survives is the shape this project already uses: one tag line per language group,
body paragraphs untagged. So section 1 is the `@brief` sentence and sections 2..6 are untagged paragraphs that open
with a bold marker, English group first, then Chinese. Migrating fifty headers to a form the formatter destroys
would have been a rewrite done twice; the pilot exists to make that impossible.
**这个形状是量出来的。** 六个 Doxygen `@par` 标题——最显然的写法——在这条流水线上不可能：`docfmt` 会把以标签开头的
正文行当成缺陷修复（文档流水线会把它归到错误的语言组），于是抹掉 `@` 并把六段并成一段。另外三种写法都被同样地重写了。
活下来的是本仓库已经在用的形状：每个语言组一个标签行，正文段落不带标签。于是第 1 段是 `@brief` 那句，第 2–6 段是不带
标签、以粗体记号开头的段落，先英文组后中文组。把五十个头迁移到一个会被格式化器毁掉的形状上，等于同一件事做两遍；试点就是
为了排除这个。
**It checks slots, not sentences.** A block can pass with six sentences of nothing. Content quality is sampling
review (plan section 9), and this file does not pretend to be that.
**它查格子，不查句子。** 六句空话也能过。内容质量靠抽样评审（计划 §9），本文件不假装那是它能做的事。
**Why `excluded` exists, and why it is not a loophole.** The biggest debt file by block count is `core/traits.hpp`,
with 27 public types -- all of them compile-time predicates (`struct is_pwm : std::false_type {};` and 52 like it).
Forcing six sections onto those would produce the exact artefact this whole line exists to prevent: a `Refusals`
section for a type that can refuse nothing, an `Equation` section with no equation. So a file whose every public
type is a trait, a tag or an empty aggregate is excluded -- with a reason, and the exclusion count is printed on
every run so it shows up in a diff. An exclusion is a review decision, not a mechanism; the one thing it may not
be is silent.
**为什么要有 `excluded`，以及它为什么不是后门。** 按块数算欠账最大的文件是 `core/traits.hpp`，27 个 public 类型——全
是编译期谓词（`struct is_pwm : std::false_type {};` 加上 52 个同类）。给它们硬套六段，恰好会产出这条线存在的目的要阻止
的那种东西：给一个无权拒绝的类型写 `Refusals`，给一条没有式子的规则写 `Equation`。所以一个文件里全部 public 类型都是
trait / 标签 / 空聚合时，它被排除——必须写理由，且排除数每次运行都会打印，因此它会出现在 diff 里。排除是一个评审决定，
不是机制；它唯一不能做的事是悄悄进行。

excluded.why: Every public type in this header is a compile-time predicate with an empty body (53 specialisations of `is_pwm`, `is_current_sense`, `is_position_sensor`, `is_dc_link` and their siblings). They hold no state, compute nothing at run time and refuse nothing: a `Guarantees` section would say "it is a trait", and a `Refusals` section would have no operand. The plan asks for the skeleton on classes that model a physical problem; these model no problem, they answer a question about a type.
